ruling.recommended_action: Close the fare dispute; no refund is due — the metered RydeTAXI fare reflects actual distance and time, and the extra time is explained by heavy rain, not by any deviation. No account action.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first: I read every written item — the rider's complaint (higher-than-expected fare in heavy rain, suspected longer route) [F1], the only chat-record entry, the driver's post-trip statement ("I followed the app route exactly. The meter is what it is; it was raining and traffic was slow") [F7], and the fact that there are no in-app chat messages at all [F6]. Nothing in these is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation aimed at the other party, so SAFE-1 and SAFE-2 are not engaged and safety_concern is "none" with no safety_basis beyond those read items.

Route: RD-1 makes each off-route segment the unit of review, and no off-route segment was measured — actual distance 8.5 km equals the optimal route 8.5 km (+0.0 km, -0%) [F1], and the billed distance likewise does not exceed the optimal route [F3]. With no unexempted segment there is nothing to refund under RD-2, and RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 have no segment to operate on, so segment_findings is empty. There is therefore no basis to find the driver breached the shortest-and-most-direct-route obligation, and no amount to compute: the metered fare's distance component (8.50 km) is exactly the shortest route's distance [F3][F5][RD-2].

Fare: this is a RydeTAXI trip, so the fare follows the meter and distance/time units enter the fare directly [F5][RD-2]. The charged $23.08 decomposes into base $3.90 + distance $11.99 (8.50 km) + time $5.72 (22.0 min) + waiting $0.00 + platform $1.47 - discount $0.00 [F5]; no element is an unpublished or unsupported add-on, and no surge applied (1.0x) [F4]. The one excess is time, 22.0 min against the 16.3 min estimate (+5.7 min) [F2], but the metered time component is what the meter incurred, and the record explains the delay without any deviation: heavy rain / thundery showers 18.5 mm [F11], speed bands 3 (20-29 km/h) on both the PIE and Airport Boulevard during the trip window 17:09-17:47 [F8][F9]. No traffic incident on the route was recorded, and none is claimed [F10]. FARE-1/FARE-2 add nothing: the fare is the metered composition and no toll/ERP overcharge is shown [F5][F8][FARE-1].

Profiles do not decide anything here: rider 795 d, rating 4.8, 0 disputes/0 upheld in 90 d [F12]; driver 1292 d, rating 4.89, 1163 trips, 1 dispute, 0 upheld [F13]. No route dispute is upheld in this case, so RD-6's precondition (upheld dispute + route_disputes_upheld_90d >= 1) fails and no flag_account is issued [F12][F13][RD-6]. Evidence is sufficient: the trip records (GPS distance, fare breakdown, timeline, traffic/weather) settle every element the outcome needs, and no ruling element depends on a missing record [F1][F3][F5].
